<details>

<summary>View all ecosystem sizes in one plot, replicates</summary>

```{r}
ggarrange(plot.metaecos.replicates.legend(ds_metaecosystems %>% filter(disturbance_percentage == "fixed"),
                                          response_variable),
          plot.metaecos.replicates(ds_metaecosystems %>% filter(disturbance_percentage == "fixed"),
                                   response_variable)  +
            rremove("xlab") +
            theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                  axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                  legend.position = "none") +
            font("ylab", size = size_y_axis) +
            ggtitle(fixed_label),
          plot.metaecos.replicates(ds_metaecosystems %>% filter(disturbance_percentage == "decreasing_with_size"),
                                   response_variable) + 
            font("xlab", size = size_y_axis) +
            font("ylab", size = size_y_axis) +
            ggtitle(relative_label) + 
            scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(ds_metaecosystems$day)) +
            theme(legend.position = "none"),
          heights = c(0.25, 0.6, 0.6),
          nrow = 3,
          align = "v")
```

</details>
